_meta.indication: Treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy

pivotal_trials.phase: Registrational efficacy trial (WU-KONG1 Part B); the confirmatory trial WU-KONG28 is the phase 3 study
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations whose disease progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy, ECOG 0 or 1
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1 by blinded independent review committee; duration of response (DOR) an additional measure
pivotal_trials.n: 85 patients randomized to ZEGFROVY 200 mg (efficacy population)
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 46% (95% CI: 35, 57) at 200 mg; median DOR 11.1 months (95% CI: 8.2, NE); 72% of responders had DOR ≥6 months

key_safety: Most common (≥20%) adverse reactions were diarrhea, rash, decreased appetite, stomatitis, fatigue, nausea. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 41%; fatal adverse reactions in 2.2%. Diarrhea occurred in 73% (2.5% Grade 3); ILD/pneumonitis in 1.7%.
target_moa: Orally bioavailable EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor that binds to and inhibits EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations and inhibits phosphorylation in cells expressing these mutations
companion_dx_detail: Life Technologies Corporation Oncomine Dx Express Test approved as a companion diagnostic to detect EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations

advisory_committee.vote: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee as no significant efficacy or safety issues were identified

surrogate_endpoint.text: Overall response rate and duration of response (intermediate clinical endpoints reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit)

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on overall response rate and duration of response [see *Clinical Studies* (14)].

While confirmed durable response of an appropriate magnitude can support an Accelerated Approval, FDA does not consider these endpoints as surrogate endpoints, but rather as intermediate clinical endpoints that are reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit and as such require a confirmatory pivotal trial to verify this benefit.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Conduct WU-KONG28 (Study DZ2022E0005, NCT05668988), a multicenter randomized trial of sunvozertinib versus platinum-based chemotherapy to verify and describe clinical benefit, including final PFS and OS

citations.quote: The trial intended to verify the clinical benefit of sunvozertinib is Study DZ2022E0005 (WU-KONG28), an open-label, randomized controlled, multiregional clinical trial of sunvozertinib versus platinum-based chemotherapy in patients with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations who are newly diagnosed or treatment-naïve.
